title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0013 R1 VOC Analyzer
summary:
- VOC Analyzer Specification for the Solana project.
- Initialing required on cover sheet only, other title block info on all pages.
- Revisions identified in the body of the specification.
- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle available from Teyma USA & Abener Engineering and Construction Services General Partnership.
- Confidentiality terms for information and know-how.
- VOC Analyzer for Heat Transfer Fluid (HTF) Leak Detection in TES Area.
- Measures Volatile Organic Compounds using Photo Ionization Detector.
- Operates at temperatures up to 750 Deg. F and pressures up to atmospheric.
- Materials include Therminol VP-1, 316 SS for body and sensor.
- Transmitter provides 4-20 mA + HART output with NEMA 4 protection.
- Accessories include mounting adapters and thermal extenders.
- Manufacturer: Turner designs, Transmitter Model: Procal 5000.
